name: NVIDIA NeMo
desc: NVIDIA's open-source toolkit for building and monitoring agents.
desc_zh: 构建、监控与优化 Agent 的开源组件套件
solves: The agent answers on Monday and has quietly drifted by Friday. Tracing, evaluation and guardrails are what tell you which part moved.
solves_zh: 周一还好好的 Agent，到周五悄悄跑偏了。链路追踪、评估和护栏能告诉你变的是哪一环。
best_for: Agents already in production, where you need to know why one answer changed.
best_for_zh: Agent 已经跑在生产上，需要查清某次输出为什么变了。
notes: The agent ops and guardrail layer enterprises bolt onto any model, including open-weight ones; date is approximate because the brand has been re-versioned repeatedly. 首次公开发布日期精度：month-only 来源：https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/ai-data-science/products/nemo/
